method: Final formatted controls against k77/pre-integration common helper source in an isolated tree; external CLI/sleeps and named read/setup boundaries substituted. Scenario pipefail is explicit. No VM.
command: failed frame read|failed snapshot read|real frame reader|on-screen read status|calibration stops|failed menu open|failed menu title read
tests: not ok 1 failed frame read stops actual click chains in plain and conditional contexts
not ok 2 failed snapshot read stops actual click chains in plain and conditional contexts
not ok 3 real frame reader propagates failed window transport before click input
not ok 4 on-screen read status one is an error rather than a clean negative
not ok 5 calibration stops on failed position reads before later scroll input
not ok 6 failed menu open stops before title reads Escape and settling
not ok 7 failed menu title read stops before Escape and settling
